# Todo app

Keep a list of tasks with a title, description, priority, due date, and mark them as done. Filter by status and edit or delete tasks.

**tasks**: title (string), description (string), priority (Low / Medium / High), due_date (string), done (boolean). Operations: list, create, update, delete.

Features:
- Form to add a task with title, description, priority, due date, and done box
- List of tasks showing title, description, priority badge, due date, and done status
- Checkbox to mark a task as done
- Edit and Delete buttons on every task
- Filter the list by status (All, To do, In progress, Done)
- Sort the list by priority (Low, Medium, High)
- Count of tasks by status and priority on the dashboard

+# Architecture
+
+**Goal:** Build a todo app: title, description, priority Low/Medium/High, due date, mark as done, filter by status, edit and delete
+
+**Preset:** fastapi-vanilla
+
+A SQLite table stores tasks. A database module offers add, list, update, and delete functions. FastAPI routes under /api/tasks call them. A single HTML page lists tasks with coloured priority badges, a form to add one, and Edit and Delete buttons on each.
+
+## Product spec
+
+### Todo app
+
+Keep a list of tasks with a title, description, priority, due date, and mark them as done. Filter by status and edit or delete tasks.
+
+**tasks**: title (string), description (string), priority (Low / Medium / High), due_date (string), done (boolean). Operations: list, create, update, delete.
+
+Features:
+- Form to add a task with title, description, priority, due date, and done box
+- List of tasks showing title, description, priority badge, due date, and done status
+- Checkbox to mark a task as done
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every task
+- Filter the list by status (All, To do, In progress, Done)
+- Sort the list by priority (Low, Medium, High)
+- Count of tasks by status and priority on the dashboard
+
+## Endpoints
+- `POST /api/tasks`: Create a new task
+- `GET /api/tasks`: List all tasks, newest first
+- `PUT /api/tasks/{id}`: Edit one task
+- `DELETE /api/tasks/{id}`: Delete one task
+
+## Web page must
+- Form with title, description, priority select (Low, Medium, High), due date input, and done checkbox and a Save button
+- List of tasks showing title, description, priority badge, due date, and done status
+- Checkbox to mark a task as done
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every task
+- Filter the list by status (All, To do, In progress, Done)
+- Sort the list by priority (Low, Medium, High)
+- Count of tasks by status and priority on the dashboard
